disable-template-filters.title: Genga - Dependency Configuration
disable-template-filters.content: By default the 'Token Magic FX' module which is now a dependency will automatically turn on 'template filters' which IMO look a little ugly, and are not needed for the functionality of this module. Would you like to disable that module setting?

notification.no: Setting Not Disabled, you can disable it at some point in the future by going into the 'Token Magic FX' settings
